method: QPC wall-clock interval summary of serialized DlssResetTrace v1 calls

scope.evaluate_cpu: end_qpc - begin_qpc is a CPU wall interval: begin QPC is sampled before BeginEvaluate records the event, and end QPC after SDK Evaluate returns but before EndEvaluate bookkeeping. Includes BeginEvaluate recorder overhead and conditional branches; excludes EndEvaluate bookkeeping. Does not measure SDK-internal CPU cycles, GPU execution time, or GPU completion
scope.between_evaluates_cpu: next begin_qpc minus prior end_qpc for consecutive actual calls with a completed prior call and no overlap; global CPU wall interval between recorded brackets, not attributable to a lock, component, GPU wait, or game pass
